about: Boards (H1 combat teeth, docs/team/hook/H1_combat_teeth.md item 6): a table arena made a board to play on rather than an open field. By place id (ArenaPlaces.IdFor), the table-night tiers it applies at; a place or tier with no board is made as it was. Numbers described in logic/Content/Boards.cs; the shape's generation is logic/Maps/ArenaBoard.cs and the place's own (Arenas/Hollow.cs). Check a board with `dotnet balance/bin/<build>/Balance.dll board --people pack --tier 1 --seed N --out plan.png`. First pass, 3 Nov: the owner, after the tier-1 Deep Shaw, 'the arena survivor area is just too big and theres no strategy to it at all'. Round 2 (3 Nov): the lamp pays less (Flare fill x1.5, ember x1.25 to x1.1) and is doused faster (12/s, a quarter of the fodder): 3-5 outs a night for holders. Holding still keeps the Pack's tier-1 night from falls (matched seeds, every bot holding against none: 4% against 30-34%), and even with no pay at all it is 5-7%: the fold's position, not the numbers, carries it. Round 2A (4 Nov, the judge: 'the fold is bigger than the screen ... the lamp object never shows ... it goes out about 3.5 s after the warning'): the fold cut to fit the play camera (wall 9-11 m, 2 m through, dressed every 2.2 m, a warm door light at both sides of each gap), the lamp's light reaching 4 m past the wall from its lantern's flame (scale 2, a bright core), its pool 7 m, douse 2/s and Flare fill x1.3: holders see 1.7-2.7 outs a night; the warning when the first snuffer comes within 12 m, wherever she is.

vault_court.about: The court before the Sealed Door (vault_opened's first stage, Corvane in the doorway; P6 and the films lead, agreed 5 Nov): the outline the set is built to, in the Vault's own ground (Play/Story/Vault.cs, north is -z). width/depth: the court's metres across and from the door out; door: the door's middle [x, z] (the gate into the south end); corvane: his mark in it; arrive: where she comes in; clear: metres round his mark kept free of anything solid (his tether and the pull's drag). Until the set lands, Vault.cs's stand-in space is Band(40.5, 21.5, 11).
